references.text: Listen of the sons of Gad - Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni - who became the fathers of the clans mentioned in Numbers 26:15, stems from this original listing of Jacob's grandsons who went to Egypt.
Another genealogical list mentioning Israelite families and clans, showing the pattern for how family records were kept in the books of Moses.
The first census of the tribe of Gad in Numbers, which provides the background for the second census in chapter 26.
Continuation of the listing of Gad's clans, completing the list of all families that descended from Gad.
